prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you want me to search for current local companies and return phone numbers/addresses, or would you prefer guidance so you can contact providers yourself?

Quick helpful info while you decide:
- Who to call: certified backflow assembly testers (BAT). Look for plumbers and fire-sprinkler shops that list “backflow testing” or “RPZ testing” and include BAT or cross‑connection control certification.
- Local places to check: City of Liberty Public Works / Water Department (they may have an approved/tester list or permit rules), Clay County plumbing contractors, and Kansas City metro backflow/testing companies — many serve Liberty.
- Typical cost: testing usually $50–$150 per device; repairs vary (parts/labor) — RPZ valve repairs can be $100–$600+ depending on parts and whether the unit must be replaced.
- What to ask a provider:
  - Are you a certified backflow assembly tester (BAT)? (Ask for certificate/ID.)
  - Do you provide written test reports and submit to the city (if required)?
  - Do you carry liability insurance?
  - Do you service my device type (irrigation RPZ, commercial RPZ, reduced-pressure principle, double-check, etc.)?
  - Do you provide repair estimates, and do you charge a service call fee?
- What to expect on the visit: tester will isolate and test the unit’s check valves/relief valve, provide a pass/fail report, and recommend repairs if it fails. If repairs are needed they may do them on-site (with parts) or replace the assembly.

If you want, tell me:
- whether this is residential irrigation, commercial, or fire sprinkler,
- how soon you need it,
and I’ll look up current providers in/near Liberty, MO and give names, phone numbers, and recommended options.
